job.clean.name: Clean Panels
job.clean.desc: Remove dust from the solar panels.
job.clean.tradeoff: Power improves, but the worker gets tired.
job.build.name: Build Shield
job.build.desc: Add blocks to the outpost shield.
job.build.tradeoff: Safety improves, but the worker gets tired.
job.maintain.name: Maintain
job.maintain.tradeoff: Air support improves, but the worker gets tired.
job.science.name: Science Walk
job.science.desc: Study the land outside the outpost.
job.science.tradeoff: Science grows, but the walker gets extra dose.
job.rest.name: Rest and Play
job.rest.desc: Give the whole crew time to rest.
job.rest.tradeoff: The crew feels better, but no work is done.
job.talk.name: Talk to Earth
job.talk.desc: Send a message to the Earth team.
job.talk.tradeoff: The crew feels better, but one slot is used.
crew.amara.name: Amara
crew.kenji.name: Kenji
crew.luz.name: Luz
em.air_leak.title: Air Leak
em.air_leak.story: A wall seal is hissing. Your air is slowly escaping.
em.air_leak.fact: Outposts need careful checks to keep air inside.
em.air_leak.earth: Earth says: patch the left wall, not the loud spot!
em.air_leak.lesson: Small checks can protect the whole crew.
em.air_leak.patch.tradeoff: Fast, but it might not work.
em.air_leak.seal_room.tradeoff: Fast and sure, but tomorrow has less work time.
em.machine_breakdown.title: Air Maker Breakdown
em.machine_breakdown.story: The Air Maker stopped. The crew must choose a safe backup.
em.machine_breakdown.fact: Machines need care when they make useful resources.
em.machine_breakdown.earth: Earth says: restart the Air Maker first.
em.machine_breakdown.lesson: A backup can help while a machine needs care.
em.machine_breakdown.restart.tradeoff: Quick, but it might not work.
em.machine_breakdown.spare_parts.tradeof: Strong repair, but it takes time and power.
em.machine_breakdown.backup_tank.tradeof: Air comes fast, but the machine stays off.
em.crew_injury.title: Crew Injury
em.crew_injury.story: A crew member needs help after a small accident.
em.crew_injury.fact: Rest and teamwork help crews handle hard days.
em.crew_injury.earth: Earth says: let Luz check the crew member.
em.crew_injury.lesson: Good care helps the whole crew keep going.
em.crew_injury.medic_treat.tradeoff: Best care, but it might not work.
em.crew_injury.rest_watch.tradeoff: Safe choice, but the crew member misses work.
em.crew_injury.carry_medbay.tradeoff: Care improves, but everyone gets tired.
em.battery_fault.title: Battery Fault
em.battery_fault.story: A battery cell is warm. The crew must protect the power system.
em.battery_fault.fact: Power systems need checks before small faults grow.
em.battery_fault.earth: Earth says: switch off the bad cell.
em.battery_fault.lesson: A calm choice can protect power for later.
em.battery_fault.isolate_cell.tradeoff: It might fail, but it protects the cell.
em.battery_fault.cool_down.tradeoff: Simple choice, but the Air Maker rests next sol.
em.battery_fault.reset_grid.tradeoff: Sure choice, but it uses power.
codex.sol.title: A Sol
codex.sol.text: A sol is one day on Mars. The game uses a simple Mars day.
codex.mars-gravity.title: Mars Gravity
codex.mars-gravity.text: Mars has less gravity than Earth. Human bodies must adapt.
codex.light-delay.title: Light Delay
codex.light-delay.text: Messages take time to travel between Earth and Mars.
codex.space-weather.title: Space Weather
codex.space-weather.text: Space weather includes changes from the active Sun.
codex.solar-flare.title: Solar Flare
codex.solar-flare.text: A solar flare is a bright burst from the Sun.
codex.cme.title: CME
codex.cme.text: A CME is a cloud of charged particles from the Sun.
codex.sep.title: SEP
codex.sep.text: SEP means solar energetic particles. They can travel through space.
codex.radiation-shielding.title: Radiation Shielding
codex.radiation-shielding.text: A shield can reduce the dose received by a crew member.
codex.dust-storms.title: Dust Storms
codex.dust-storms.text: Dust can block sunlight from reaching solar panels.
codex.solar-panels.title: Solar Panels
codex.solar-panels.text: Solar panels make power when light reaches their surface.
codex.making-oxygen.title: Making Oxygen
codex.making-oxygen.text: A machine can make oxygen for a Mars outpost.
codex.orbiters.title: Orbiters
codex.orbiters.text: Orbiters can watch Mars and share useful weather data.
codex.why-exercise.title: Why Exercise
codex.why-exercise.text: Exercise helps a crew stay ready during a mission.
codex.teamwork-rest.title: Teamwork and Rest
codex.teamwork-rest.text: Teams work better when people share tasks and rest.

ui.commanderHelp: More events and less room for mistakes.
ui.classroomHelp: A shorter 10-sol mission for a group.

ui.shelterHelp: Shelter lowers storm dose, but leaves one job slot.
ui.forecastHelp: Look ahead for storms and plan early.
ui.nextSolHelp: Check the forecast, choose jobs, and keep the outpost safe.

ui.objectiveDefault: Keep the crew safe while you improve the outpost.
ui.story1: Landing day. Your crew wakes the small Mars outpost.
ui.story5: The base is settling in. Strong routines keep small problems small.

ui.story25: Final approach. Every safe sol brings the crew closer to home.
ui.story30: Mission complete. The crew made it through 30 sols.
ui.storyOngoing: Another sol begins. Watch the sky, the machines, and the crew.
